images.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Make a production-ready BACKGROUND ART asset for this game's actual Unity UI, using the attached title-screen concept. Preserve the exact gorgeous navy cosmic universe, teal and violet nebula, metallic gold/mineral modeled facilities and large cyan faceted planetary core visual language. REMOVE ALL typography, letters, logos, emblems, buttons, HUD, frame borders and interface graphics. This is a background image only. Recompose as a clean wide 16:9 landscape: keep the LEFT 45 percent dark and quiet for real interactive menu controls that will be rendered later in Unity, with only faint stars; cluster the beautifully solid 3D modeled planetary core and its five complementary facilities in the RIGHT 55 percent, with the main cyan core around 73 percent across and 60 percent down. Include collector curved prongs, triangular condenser, double-ring ignition forge, faceted satellite and a subtle shield mesh on a shared restrained cosmic base. Delicate elemental wisps around the perimeter, no extra characters or ships, no dense visual noise. Controlled bloom, fine polished materials, visually cohesive and highly detailed. No text anywhere, no watermark, no fake transparency. Aim for 2560x1440 or higher, 16:9.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW production game UI ICON ATLAS matching only the gorgeous luminous elemental art style of the reference. A SQUARE canvas containing an EXACT UNIFORM 4 by 4 grid of equal square cells. Transparent background with genuine alpha, no colored backdrop, no checkerboard baked into pixels. Fourteen separate icon sprites, each centered in its own cell with 22 percent transparent padding on every side and NO overlap or glow crossing cell boundaries. Last two cells must remain completely empty transparent. No plinths, labels, text, numbers, UI tiles, borders, rings or scene background. Full icons, not cut off. Layout is STRICT, row-major left to right:
ROW 1: WATER cyan floating droplet; FIRE orange flame; WIND silver-teal spiral ribbons; SMOKE soft purple-gray smoke puff.
ROW 2: ICE sharp pale-blue ice shards; EARTH warm tan floating rock fragments; LIGHTNING jagged violet-white plasma bolt; LIGHT radiant white-gold starburst ray.
ROW 3: CRYSTAL ordered purple crystalline shards; DECAY chartreuse radioactive decay sparks and motes; DARK MATTER black-centered orb with subtle violet rim; GRAVITY violet concentric lensing rings.
ROW 4: MAGNETISM intertwined cyan-violet magnetic loops; LIFE fresh green leaf-like life sparks; EMPTY; EMPTY.
Each sprite has a distinctive clear silhouette at small UI scale, high-quality stylized 3D/VFX rendering, controlled sharp bloom, bright highlights and darker structural detail, consistent visual weight. Reference is STYLE ONLY, do not reproduce its screenshot, base, controls or label typography. Output only the square transparent atlas, no watermark.
